title: Vikunja 2.3.0 before 2.8.0 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation in the CSV migration module because it does not…
description: Vikunja versions from 2.3.0 up to but not including 2.8.0 contain a vulnerability in the CSV migration module where uncontrolled memory allocation can occur. This happens because the module does not de-duplicate label column mappings or limit the number of labels per row before building the full import. Authenticated users can exploit this by sending a specially crafted request to the migration endpoint, causing the server to exhaust memory and potentially crash due to out-of-memory conditions.
